messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing_quality_anomaly HIGH for policy=cost-led-routing on route=chat-standard. Metric: quality_score_drop > 0.25 sustained over 5m. See https://infra/alerts/2154321000 :rotating_light:

jules: I'm oncall. acknowledging and triaging now. pulling up sample traces and policy decision logs.

nate: noticing a rapid switch to variant `gpt-lite-q4` starting 03:08 UTC after the cost optimizer rollout. eval-run A (safety prompts) avg score 0.89 -> 0.48. spike in paraphrase/hallucinated-fact markers.

kim: if we can, flip the routing to the standby stable variant `gpt-base-fp16` while we investigate. That should restore quality quickly.

jules: executing emergency revert:
```
redctl routes set-variant --route chat-standard --variant gpt-base-fp16 --mode immediate --reason "emergency quality revert"
```

jules: command returned OK. routing drift corrected, ~87% of traffic moved within 70s.

yana: adding that we already have 23 customer reports in the support queue (tickets: #7342, #7344, #7347...). Forwarding top examples to eng.

samir: product ask: what's the blast radius? which regions/customers saw the low-quality responses?

nate: metrics: impacted region = eu-central + us-west. peak impacted qps ~3.1k, approx 78k requests between 03:08-03:30 UTC. affected tenants include: content-editor-pro, assist-ai, billing-chat. Auto-eval flagged ~6.1% of responses as failing safety/accuracy heuristics.

lee: deployed quick observability change: instrumented `decision_reason` and `chosen_variant` headers for a 1h window and started a debug mirror to s3://incidents/2154321000/mirror.jsonl.

kim: quick root cause note: optimizer introduced a cost-only promotion rule for low-latency routes without requiring a min-quality threshold. `gpt-lite-q4` passed perf tests but not full fidelity evals. It was inadvertently included in production candidate set.

jules: mitigation steps performed: 1) emergency route pin to `gpt-base-fp16`; 2) temporarily rollback optimizer rollout via `deployctl rollback optimizer-v2 -> optimizer-v1`; 3) added runtime deny for quantized-lite variants on customer-facing routes.

jules: rollback cmd output: optimizer rollback started, will finish in ~3m.

samir: communications: support, please send an initial note to impacted customers acknowledging the regression and that routing was reverted; offer remediation assistance.

yana: sending message now. draft: "We detected that a cost-optimization caused a lower-quality model variant to be selected for some requests. We reverted routing and are investigating root cause; we'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and offer support."

nate: immediate follow-ups: add a quality-gate to optimizer that requires any promoted variant to meet a delta <= 0.05 vs baseline on the canonical eval suite; add canary restriction to exclude high-fidelity routes from cost-led promotions.

kim: propose adding a hard blacklist for `*-lite-*` variants until we have validated eval coverage. I'll own the optimizer patch. ETA 4h for PR + canary.

lee: ops asks: keep debug mirror for 48h. also increase retention of request traces for route `chat-standard` to 72h for RCA.

jules: taking handoff. I'll be primary oncall for the next 2.5h, then hand to nate. logging this in the incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/2154321000.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Postmortem required within 72 hours.

nate: quick customer impact numbers added to the doc and evidence bucket. Also adding replication test that simulates cost-led promotions under traffic patterns to catch this class of regression.

kim: uploading sampled bad responses + traces to s3://incidents/2154321000/samples.json (sanitized).

yana: outreach done to affected customers; 6 customers asked for priority help and we've scheduled live troubleshooting sessions.

jules: monitoring shows quality metrics trending back towards baseline after revert. latency unchanged. marking incident state = monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to RESOLVED (monitoring). Reminder: create full postmortem and track actions: optimizer-quality-gate (kim), blacklist-duration (jules), increased-trace-retention (lee), customer-followup (yana).
